# Phoenix Valley Plumber

> Licensed plumbing referral and dispatch service for Phoenix and the surrounding Valley communities in Arizona.

## Business & Licensing Facts
- Operating Brand: Phoenix Valley Plumber
- Website: https://phoenixvalleyplumber.com
- Main Dispatch Phone: (602) 835-0102
- Operating Model: Dispatch and marketing service connecting consumers with verified licensed contractor.
- Licensed Arizona Contractor: Phoenix Valley Plumber
- Arizona ROC License: ROC #348219 (Class CR-37: Commercial & Residential Plumbing)
- Verification Portal: Verify at Arizona Registrar of Contractors (roc.az.gov)
- Primary Service Area: Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, Surprise, Goodyear, Avondale, Queen Creek, Buckeye, AZ.
